errors.evidence: The description confusingly states the years on the x-axis are arranged in alphabetical order, before correcting itself in parentheses. The years are arranged chronologically, not alphabetically.
The description states that each bar contains six layers, but the legend lists seven distinct categories of financial instruments.
The description incorrectly maps the color dark blue ("тъмносиньо") to the category "Акции на АДСИЦ". According to the legend and the chart, this category is represented by a dark red/maroon color.

The description states that the lowest value for the year 2019 is approximately 300 million BGN, but the bar in the chart for 2019 reaches a value just under 400 million BGN (approximately 380 million).
